levels.surface: عبد الله بن، عامر بن ربيعة

notes: Second isnad («وعن ابن شهاب عن سالم بن عبد الله») gives the same report through a different transmitter: variant, never a route of the first
«أن عمر خرج» is the story: Umar is in the scene, not a link; Abd al-Rahman b. Awf relays the Prophet's words, so he is the last link
